source_text: On 12 January 2024, Prime Minister Rishi Sunak signed a 10-year bilateral security agreement with President Volodymyr Zelenskiy of Ukraine in Kyiv. source_text: Sweden became the 32nd member of NATO on March 7, 2024, after Hungary became the final ally to ratify its accession, ending two centuries of Swedish military non-alignment. The accession was completed when Sweden's Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson deposited the instrument of accession in Washington.

source_text: BRUSSELS, December 18 - The Council of the European Union today adopted a 12th package of restrictive measures against Russia, banning imports of Russian non-industrial diamonds and tightening the price cap on Russian oil. The package adds 147 individuals and 87 entities to the EU sanctions list and tightens enforcement of the existing oil price cap of USD 60 per barrel.

source_text: VIENNA - The International Atomic Energy Agency reported that Iran's stockpile of uranium enriched to up to 60 percent purity grew by 22.6 kilograms in the latest reporting period, reaching 142.1 kilograms as of February 10, 2024. source_text: DUBAI - Houthi forces in Yemen have launched at least 27 attacks on commercial shipping in the Red Sea since November 19, 2023, according to the U.S. Central Command. The attacks have prompted major carriers including Maersk and Hapag-Lloyd to reroute vessels around the Cape of Good Hope, adding roughly 10 days and significant fuel cost to Asia-Europe voyages.

source_text: GENEVA, December 9 - A World Trade Organization dispute panel ruled on Friday that U.S. tariffs imposed under Section 232 on steel and aluminum imports from China, Norway, Switzerland and Turkey violated WTO rules. The panel rejected the U.S. argument that the tariffs were justified by 'essential security interests'. The ruling does not require the United States to remove the tariffs immediately.

notes: US argued essential security; panel rejected. Ruling not self-executing.
